result.summary: NSTEMI with cardiogenic shock and heart failure required coronary stenting and balloon-pump support documented on May 23; ongoing pump use is not confirmed. C. difficile enterocolitis supports enteric contact isolation, and disorientation supports fall precautions. Acute kidney injury improved by May 29, but hematuria/urethral injury and anticoagulant use remain relevant care concerns; no invasive ventilation or specific active drips, vascular lines, or tubes are documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: C. difficile detected by stool PCR during this encounter, with diagnosed C. difficile enterocolitis; supports enteric contact precautions.
